author: musho7-dev
subject: Add viral plan and design review (docs/VIRAL_PLAN.md); sea horizon fix
body:
Overnight analysis: what's strong, what's missing for sharing and
retention, a prioritized viral feature plan, design review of first-run,
HUD, results screen and garage, monetization and launch checklist, and
ideas for more vehicles, maps and modes. Also raises the Sunny Beach sea
so it reads as a horizon.
